overview.overview:
Alaska is expected to back the Republican nominee in 2028, with the central estimate pointing to a margin of roughly six and a half points. The state voted Republican by about 10 points in 2020 and about 13 points in 2024, and it leans well to the right of the country as a whole.

The range of plausible outcomes is wide, running from a Republican margin of about 16 points to a narrow Democratic result, though a Democratic win sits at the far edge of that range. No state polls or home-state candidate information are currently available, so the outlook rests mainly on recent results and national conditions. Alaska's three electoral votes are unlikely to decide the Electoral College.
overview.watch: A sustained shift in national opinion or the emergence of Alaska-specific polling showing a much closer race would most change this outlook.
key_factors: Republicans carried Alaska by about 10 points in 2020 and about 13 points in 2024.
Alaska leans roughly 12 points more Republican than the nation as a whole.
No public polling or home-state candidate information is available yet.
